h1: The Bedrooms Hostel Pattaya — A 3-Minute Walk to Pattaya Beach for a Few Hundred Baht
intro: If you're coming to Pattaya solo or with friends and want a clean bed in a central location, within walking distance of the beach and Walking Street, on a budget — The Bedrooms Hostel Pattaya is a name that comes up often in reviews. It's a 2-star hostel that opened in 2016 on Pattaya Beach Road Soi 1, just about 220 metres from Pattaya Beach. There are both female/male dorm beds and private rooms with shared bathrooms, plus a shared kitchen, free parking and a 24-hour front desk. Rates start from approx. ฿280/night for a dorm bed, and it scores 9.1 from 247 reviews on Trip.com and 8.5 on Booking.com (location 9.3, cleanliness 8.8).

body.html: The Bedrooms Hostel's selling point is clear from the start — its central Pattaya location. It sits on Pattaya Beach Road Soi 1, about 220 metres from the beach, just a few minutes' walk to the sand. Most real guest reviews agree the location is the highlight (location scores 9.3 on Booking.com) — a walk to the beach, close to Walking Street, restaurants, convenience stores, and songthaew pick-up points all around. For travellers who want the beach by day and a stroll through town by night, the position is hard to beat.

There are around 24 rooms/units in total, split between female and male dorm beds and private rooms — twin and double — all with shared bathrooms. Every room is air-conditioned, which guests say keeps things comfortably cool. Many reviews say the beds are comfortable and it's cleaner than the price suggests (cleanliness scores 8.8), the shared bathrooms are clean, and there's a washing machine and dryer to use. Just set expectations for the price and type — rooms are fairly small, this is a simple hostel rather than a hotel room, and even the private rooms share bathrooms with others.

"Great location, just a few minutes' walk to the beach. The room was small but clean and the bed genuinely comfortable, the front-desk staff were friendly — at this price, in the centre of Pattaya, it's really good value."

The common areas have a shared kitchen, a bar and a lounge that guests say is spacious enough to work in or meet other travellers. There's a massage room, luggage storage, a 24-hour front desk, and an in-room safe. What sets this hostel apart from others in the area is free private parking — a rarity for a hostel in central Pattaya. Wi-Fi is free throughout, and the front-desk staff earn praise for being friendly and helpful.

To be honest about what to know before booking. The most common note from guests is noise — it's a city-centre hostel, so you'll hear some sound from neighbouring rooms and the street, especially at night when Pattaya is lively; light sleepers should pack earplugs or ask for a quieter room. Second, rooms are fairly small in the hostel style, so big luggage can feel cramped. A few reviews mention slow follow-up on lost items and the CCTV system, so it's worth always keeping valuables in the safe. These are par for the course in a budget hostel at this level and don't drag the overall score down.

Rates start from about ฿280/night for a bed in the female dorm. Male dorm beds and private twin rooms move up to roughly ฿350–฿550, and private double rooms run around ฿550–฿800 depending on dates. On long weekends and in high season — when Pattaya is busy — prices rise and beds sell out fast. It scores 9.1 from 247 reviews on Trip.com and 8.5 on Booking.com (location 9.3, cleanliness 8.8, value 8.7) — reflecting a well-located, good-value hostel in the heart of Pattaya.

In short, The Bedrooms Hostel is ideal for solo travellers, couples or groups of friends on a budget who want a clean bed in central Pattaya, within walking distance of the beach and Walking Street. If you expect a private room with an en-suite bathroom, quiet, or hotel-style facilities, this isn't it. But if you're after a brilliantly located hostel for a few hundred baht that's still clean and has free parking — it's good value in Pattaya.

A tip from following the reviews here closely: if you're noise-sensitive, ask for a room away from the street or a quieter floor, and pack earplugs for the night. Always keep valuables in the safe. If you're travelling as a pair and want some privacy, look at the private double room (still a shared bathroom) — better value than booking two dorm beds. And because there's free parking, anyone driving to Pattaya will save a lot on city parking.

honestSummary: The Bedrooms Hostel Pattaya is the best budget choice for travellers who want a clean bed in central Pattaya, within walking distance of the beach and Walking Street, for a few hundred baht — location and value are the strengths guests agree on, plus there's rare free parking. Just accept that you'll hear some noise at night, rooms are small, and even the private rooms use shared bathrooms.
honestChecks: If you're a light sleeper or noise-sensitive — this is a city-centre hostel and you'll hear neighbouring rooms and the street at night → ask for a room away from the street or a quieter floor, and pack earplugs.

If you want a private room with an en-suite bathroom — here even the private rooms use shared bathrooms → for a private bathroom and full privacy, look at midrange options like The Agate Pattaya or Long Beach Garden.
If you're travelling as a family or with lots of luggage — rooms are fairly small and geared to budget travellers → it suits solo travellers, couples or groups of friends better.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — The Bedrooms Hostel Pattaya

faq.q: Where is The Bedrooms Hostel Pattaya, and how close is the beach?
faq.a: The Bedrooms Hostel is on Pattaya Beach Road Soi 1 in central Pattaya, about 220 metres from Pattaya Beach — roughly a 3-minute walk · it's close to Central Festival Pattaya Beach (~6 min by car) · Tiffany's Show is about 7 minutes by car · Walking Street about 10 minutes · U-Tapao Airport about 45 minutes.

faq.q: How much does The Bedrooms Hostel Pattaya cost, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start from about ฿280/night for a bed in the female dorm · male dorm beds and private twin rooms run roughly ฿350–฿550 · private double rooms about ฿550–฿800 depending on dates · all rooms are air-conditioned and use shared bathrooms · prices rise on long weekends and beds sell out fast — compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does The Bedrooms Hostel Pattaya have private rooms, and are bathrooms en-suite?
faq.a: There are private rooms in both twin and double configurations · but all of them use shared bathrooms — none are en-suite · if you need a private bathroom, consider midrange options like The Agate Pattaya or Long Beach Garden instead.

faq.q: Who is The Bedrooms Hostel Pattaya best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for solo travellers, couples or groups of friends on a budget who want a clean bed in central Pattaya, within walking distance of the beach and Walking Street · great for backpackers and self-drivers (free parking) · it's not for families with young children or those wanting quiet and a private bathroom.

faq.q: Does The Bedrooms Hostel Pattaya have parking and a kitchen?
faq.a: Yes · free private parking, which is very rare for a central Pattaya hostel, and a shared kitchen to use · there's also a bar, a massage room, luggage storage, a 24-hour front desk, an in-room safe, and free Wi-Fi throughout.

faq.q: Is The Bedrooms Hostel Pattaya quiet, or is it noisy?
faq.a: It's a city-centre hostel, and several guests note you'll hear some sound from neighbouring rooms and the street, especially at night when Pattaya is lively · ask for a room away from the street or a quieter floor, and pack earplugs · overall it's par for the course for a central hostel at this level.
